name: CloudMoo
description: Self-hosted multi-cloud infrastructure monitoring for AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, Linode, and UpCloud.

DJANGO_SECRET_KEY.description: A generated cryptographic signing key for this installation.

APP_DOMAIN.description: Optional public hostname without https://. Heroku/CloudMoo will infer the generated hostname when the platform exposes it; set this for a custom domain or reliable email links.

DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated accepted hosts. Keep .herokuapp.com for the default Heroku domain; add any custom domain after deployment.

DJANGO_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.description: Trusted HTTPS origins for the generated Heroku hostname. Add a custom origin if you attach a custom domain.

RATE_LIMIT_TRUST_X_FORWARDED_FOR.description: Trust Heroku's router-supplied client address for authentication throttling.

REGISTRATION_OPEN.description: Leave true for the first account, then set false after the instance owner has verified their account.
